process_issues.description: Gated roster for a 3-file, docs-only skill change (+9/-5): spawned docs and conventions. Skipped correctness (no code logic), security (no trust boundary change; the CI-protocol prose edits narrow spec sources to same-repo GitHub issues), context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety (no .github/workflows), maintainability (off default roster), and spec (no closing issue or --spec).

The checkout's `git status` showed changes outside the PR diff: `.env.example` was modified, and dotfiles at the repo root were untracked (.bash_profile, .bashrc, .gitconfig, .profile, .zprofile, .zshrc, .idea, .vscode, .mcp.json, .ripgreprc). They didn't affect this review, which read the PR's own files from .claude-pr/ and the commit diffs, but they suggest the runner's working tree is polluted.
Grep reported line 48 of .claude-pr/.claude/skills/pr-ci-review/SKILL.md as an omitted long matching line, so the reviewer saw only the `mcp` substring match there.
